What a sponsorship label tells readers

Small publishers use several labels for paid work. Each label tells the reader a different thing about who paid and who wrote the text.

Sponsored

A sponsored post is paid content that the publisher writes for an advertiser.

Advertisement

An advertisement is copy that the advertiser writes and supplies.

Partner content

Partner content comes from a long-term business partner.

Readers trust a label more when the publisher uses the same words on every page.
